note: Real calibrated named-gold library assembled by the competitor-recon (competitor-assessment-named-gold) worker in M3. One named gold per in-app core surface (the 6 surfaces the future app will build) + 3 design-ref benchmarks (Linear/Vercel/Apple). Each entry carries a calibrated anatomy: a screenshot_ref resolving to a real public-web/app-store capture under gold/screenshots/, >=2 scored dimensions (name + numeric 0-100 score + rationale), and prose. The future Tier-2 adversarial teardown grades artifacts against these entries. HONEST SCOPE: anatomies are calibrated from PUBLIC marketing + app-store + existing research only (see gold/LIMITATIONS.md); no authenticated in-app mobile screens were captured.
north_star_metric: >=30% Week-2 activated retention = >=3 readiness-adjusted sessions in 14 days

design_ref_dimension_law_map.token_discipline: Doctrine L4-1/L4-2 (Digital Atelier tokens exact + orange restraint)

dimensions.name: reduction_to_one_number
dimensions.rationale: Collapses a mass of overnight physiological data into a single 0-100 Readiness score plus one plain-language line, giving an instant low-effort morning verdict. This is the gold standard for the daily readiness/home glance.

dimensions.name: activation_clarity
dimensions.rationale: The first action of the day becomes 'check my Readiness'; the home screen makes the next-step guidance ('Pay attention' / 'Good to go') unambiguous, driving the daily return habit that maps to Week-2 activation.

dimensions.name: personal_baseline_trust
dimensions.rationale: Scores are relative to the user's own accumulated baseline, so the number feels personal and trustworthy rather than generic, which is what earns the daily open.

anatomy.prose: Oura is the named gold for daily readiness/home because it proves a single authored, personal Readiness number plus one coaching sentence can anchor the entire daily wake-up loop. The reduction mechanic (many signals -> one verdict) and baseline personalization are exactly what TransformFit must match so opening the app feels like a coach who already checked your recovery and adjusted today.

dimensions.name: time_to_log
dimensions.rationale: Minimal taps per set with an auto-advancing rest timer makes logging the path of least resistance during a workout; the active-set surface is the canonical frictionless logger.

dimensions.name: inline_previous_performance
dimensions.rationale: Last session's weight x reps are surfaced inline so the user applies progressive overload without leaving the screen, turning the logger into a decision aid and a 'beat your last numbers' return trigger.

dimensions.name: authored_experience
dimensions.rationale: Clean, purpose-built lifting UI rather than a generic form; the set/rest/next rhythm is authored for the active-set moment.

anatomy.prose: Hevy is the named gold for workout logging/active-set: it shows that logging speed plus inline history is the whole game for the active-set surface. TransformFit must match this effortless loop or its readiness-adjusted coaching never gets a chance to land mid-workout.

dimensions.name: coach_presence
dimensions.rationale: The debrief is a personalized coach message referencing specific logged performance ('you recovered quickly between sets; that Zone 2 work is paying off') -- a specific observation plus a forward hook, the exact coach-presence pattern.

dimensions.name: activation_clarity
dimensions.rationale: The post-session touch is a human accountability return trigger that drives the reported 'more consistent within 4 weeks' activation; the debrief makes the next session feel anticipated, not optional.

dimensions.name: authored_experience
dimensions.rationale: The debrief feels like a text from a real coach, not a templated summary -- the north-star feeling TransformFit is chasing.

anatomy.prose: Future is the named gold for the post-session debrief / coach-presence surface and for the mission's north-star feeling ('a text from a coach who watched your last workout'). TransformFit's bet is to deliver Future's coach-presence retention driver at software margins via deterministic readiness adjustment plus authored narration.

dimensions.name: investment_building_funnel
dimensions.rationale: The long conversational quiz builds commitment-and-consistency before the user sees the app, then presents a personalized projection and plan -- one of the most effective activation funnels in consumer health.

dimensions.name: personalization_payoff
dimensions.rationale: Onboarding answers are visibly converted into a tailored plan and goal projection, so the user feels seen and is activated before paying.

dimensions.name: activation_clarity
dimensions.rationale: The first-run produces a concrete personalized next step and projected outcome, which is the activation lever; (caveat: Noom's cancel-flow friction is a banned dark-pattern, not to be copied).

anatomy.prose: Noom is the named gold for onboarding/first-run: a personalized, investment-building intake plus a daily micro-habit loop drives activation. TransformFit must reproduce the activation craft while honoring 'never gate the core loop, no dark patterns, paywall Day-15 only.'

dimensions.name: deterministic_engine_plus_narration
dimensions.rationale: A weekly recalibration engine recomputes expenditure and macro targets from the user's own trend and narrates the change -- code owns the decision, copy explains it (the L6 invariant), producing a calibrated personal trend view.

dimensions.name: data_compounding_return_trigger
dimensions.rationale: Targets visibly adapt every week, so the user has a recurring reason to return and log; skipping degrades the algorithm working for them -- a strong stickiness mechanic.

dimensions.name: trend_legibility
dimensions.rationale: Weight-trend smoothing, expenditure-over-time, and adherence charts make progress legible and show the system reacting to the user.

anatomy.prose: MacroFactor is the named gold for progress/trends: a deterministic engine plus honest narration produces a calibrated, personal trend that earns the return visit -- directly analogous to TransformFit's readiness-adjusted loop and the Week-2 activation metric.

dimensions.name: value_before_gate
dimensions.rationale: Whoop bundles the hardware into the membership and ties the upgrade to ongoing daily value (recovery/strain/sleep), so the paywall is framed as continued access to a personalized loop rather than a feature lock -- a non-dark-pattern upgrade model.

dimensions.name: honest_framing
dimensions.rationale: The subscription is presented as the product (membership = device + app), an honest value exchange that avoids fake scarcity; a useful contrast to Noom's cancel-flow friction.

dimensions.name: activation_clarity
dimensions.rationale: The upgrade keeps the daily readiness loop -- the core habit -- intact, consistent with TransformFit's 'never gate the core loop / paywall Day-15 only' law.

anatomy.prose: Whoop is the named gold for the paywall/upgrade surface as an honest, value-led model: the membership is the product and the upgrade preserves the core daily loop rather than holding it hostage. TransformFit's paywall must follow this ethical pattern (Day-15 only, never gate the readiness score, no dark patterns).

dimensions.name: token_discipline
dimensions.rationale: Ruthless, restrained palette and a tight type scale on a near-black canvas -- the L4-1/L4-2 token + accent-restraint discipline TransformFit's Digital Atelier targets.

dimensions.name: authored_experience
dimensions.rationale: Every surface feels intentionally authored with motion as meaning, clearing the L4-3 authored-experience >=86 bar; nothing reads as off-the-shelf.

dimensions.name: no_generic_templates
dimensions.rationale: Bespoke layout and components, not a generic SaaS template -- the L4-5 standard.

dimensions.name: activation_clarity
dimensions.rationale: Hierarchy drives the eye to the primary action without clutter, clearing the L4-4 activation-clarity >=82 bar.

anatomy.prose: Linear is a design-ref calibration target for L4: token discipline, authored experience, no generic templates, and activation clarity. Its restraint and intentional motion are the visual-quality bar TransformFit screens are graded against by the future Tier-2 teardown.

dimensions.name: token_discipline
dimensions.rationale: High-contrast monochrome system with disciplined accent use on a black background -- the L4-1/L4-2 token + restraint standard.

dimensions.name: authored_experience
dimensions.rationale: Crafted spacing, typography, and code-aesthetic detailing clear the L4-3 authored-experience >=86 bar.

dimensions.name: no_generic_templates
dimensions.rationale: Distinctive, owned visual language rather than a generic template -- the L4-5 standard.

dimensions.name: activation_clarity
dimensions.rationale: Clear primary CTA and uncluttered hierarchy clear the L4-4 activation-clarity >=82 bar.

anatomy.prose: Vercel is a design-ref calibration target for L4: monochrome token discipline, authored detailing, no generic templates, and clear activation. It anchors the high-contrast, restrained aesthetic TransformFit's dark Digital Atelier system aspires to.

dimensions.name: token_discipline
dimensions.rationale: Tightly controlled type, spacing, and color system with restrained accent use -- the L4-1/L4-2 token discipline benchmark.

dimensions.name: authored_experience
dimensions.rationale: Product-photography-led, narrative scroll with motion as meaning clears the L4-3 authored-experience >=86 bar; the canonical authored marketing surface.

dimensions.name: no_generic_templates
dimensions.rationale: Wholly bespoke per-product layouts, never a generic template -- the L4-5 standard.

dimensions.name: activation_clarity
dimensions.rationale: Each section drives one clear action (learn more / buy) with unmistakable hierarchy, clearing the L4-4 activation-clarity >=82 bar.

anatomy.prose: Apple is a design-ref calibration target for L4: token discipline, deeply authored experience, no generic templates, and clear activation. It is the benchmark for narrative, motion-led authorship that TransformFit's screens are calibrated against.
